options.name: bearer_token
options.description: The NetScaler Console Cloud bearer token.

options.name: change_stylebook
options.description: 'true' if stylebook needs to be changed. Defaults to 'false'

options.name: check_create
options.description: Check if the configpack was created on the target netscaler console. Return the created configpack in the module results.

options.name: check_create_delay
options.description: Time in seconds to wait between the create/update operation and retrieval of the created configpack. This delay should be non zero as the newly created/updated configpack might not be immediately available to be fetched by the target NetScaler Console.

options.name: customer_id
options.description: The NetScaler Console Cloud customer id.

options.name: instance_ip
options.description: The target Netscaler instance ip address to which all underlying NITRO API calls will be proxied to. It is meaningful only when having set C(netscaler_console_proxy_call) to C(true)

options.name: instances_password
options.description: Target instances password. Required when `Prompt Credentials for instance Login` is enabled in Console System Configuration

options.name: instances_username
options.description: Target instances username. Required when `Prompt Credentials for instance Login` is enabled in Console System Configuration

options.name: is_cloud
options.description: Boolean flag. Set to true when executing modules against the Console service.

options.name: netscaler_console_proxy_call
options.description: If true the underlying NITRO API calls made by the module will be proxied through a NetScaler Console node to the target Netscaler instance. When true you must also define the following options: I(nitro_auth_token), I(instance_ip).

options.name: nitro_auth_token
options.description: The authentication token provided by a login operation.

options.name: nitro_pass
options.description: The password with which to authenticate to the netscaler node.

options.name: nitro_protocol
options.description: Which protocol to use when accessing the nitro API objects.

options.name: nitro_timeout
options.description: Time in seconds until a timeout error is thrown when establishing a new session with Netscaler

options.name: nitro_user
options.description: The username with which to authenticate to the netscaler node.

options.name: nsip
options.description: The ip address of the netscaler appliance where the nitro API calls will be made. The port can be specified with the colon (:). E.g. 192.168.1.1:555.

options.name: old_stylebook
options.description: The old stylebook to which configpack was associated before the upgrade This dictionary should be present if `change_stylebook` is true.

options.name: parameters
options.description: The parameters to be used for the configpack.

options.name: save_config
options.description: If true the module will save the configuration on the netscaler node if it makes any changes. The module will not save the configuration on the netscaler node if it made no changes.

options.name: state
options.description: The state of the resource being configured by the module on the netscaler node. When present the resource will be created if needed and configured according to the module's parameters. When absent the resource will be deleted from the netscaler node.

options.name: stylebook
options.description: The stylebook to be used for the configpack.

options.name: targets
options.description: The targets to which the configpack is to be applied.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If C(no), SSL certificates will not be validated. This should only be used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates.
